local function extent(e)
 local c=e.UITransformComponent:GetWorldCorners()
 for i=1,4 do c[i]=_TitleUI.titleGroup.UITransformComponent:ToLocalPoint(Vector3(c[i].x,c[i].y,0)) end
 return math.min(c[1].x,c[3].x),math.max(c[1].x,c[3].x),math.min(c[1].y,c[3].y),math.max(c[1].y,c[3].y)
end
local coin=_RewardFlyUI.coinBadge
local diamond=_RewardFlyUI.diamondBadge
for _,e in ipairs({coin,diamond}) do
 local t=e.UITransformComponent
 assert(t.RectSize.x==220 and t.RectSize.y==52,'Badge dimensions')
 assert(t.anchoredPosition.y==-16,'Badge raised position')
 assert(e:GetChildByName('Bg').SpriteGUIRendererComponent.ImageRUID.DataId=='c053aa01dfe8479e94dbe0100079ce51','New frame')
end
assert(coin.UITransformComponent.anchoredPosition.x==-30-_MobileScreenFitLogic.LobbyBadgeShiftX,'Coin moved right')
assert(diamond.UITransformComponent.anchoredPosition.x==-262-_MobileScreenFitLogic.LobbyBadgeShiftX,'Diamond moved right')
local _,coinRight,coinBottom=extent(coin)
local _,diamondRight,diamondBottom=extent(diamond)
local root=_TitleUI.titleGroup.UITransformComponent
local _,rootRight=extent(_TitleUI.titleGroup)
assert(rootRight-coinRight>=229,'Native UI clearance lost')
for _,name in ipairs({'SkillPanel','RelicPanel'}) do
 local surface=_EntityService:GetEntityByPath('/ui/TitleGroup/'..name..'/ContentSurface')
 local _,_,_,top=extent(surface)
 assert(coinBottom-top>=8 and diamondBottom-top>=8,'Badge touches panel '..name..' gap='..tostring(coinBottom-top)..' root='..tostring(root.RectSize)..' pos='..tostring(surface.UITransformComponent.anchoredPosition)..' scale='..tostring(surface.UITransformComponent.Scale))
 log('[CurrencyBadgeQA] gap='..name..' coin='..tostring(coinBottom-top)..' diamond='..tostring(diamondBottom-top))
end

_EntityService:GetEntityByPath('/ui/TitleGroup/TabBar/BtnRelic'):SendEvent(ButtonClickEvent())
_TitleUI.btnDiaShop.Entity:SendEvent(ButtonClickEvent())
assert(_TitleUI.shopPanel.Enable and not _TitleUI.relicPanel.Enable,'Plus button shop navigation')

local root=_TitleUI.titleGroup.UITransformComponent
local saved=root.RectSize
for _,size in ipairs({Vector2(1920,1080),Vector2(2048,960),Vector2(2560,1080),Vector2(1440,1080)}) do
 root.RectSize=size
 _MobileScreenFitLogic:FitLobbyPanelArt()
 _MobileScreenFitLogic:FitLobbyBadges()
 local expected=math.min(1,(root.RectSize.x-40)/1880,(root.RectSize.y-170)/903)
 for _,name in ipairs({'SkillPanel','RelicPanel'}) do
  local panel=_EntityService:GetEntityByPath('/ui/TitleGroup/'..name)
  local surface=panel:GetChildByName('ContentSurface').UITransformComponent
  assert(math.abs(surface.Scale.x-expected)<.001,'Simulated surface scaling')
  local top=panel.UITransformComponent.anchoredPosition.y+surface.anchoredPosition.y+surface.RectSize.y*surface.Scale.y/2
  local bottom=root.RectSize.y/2+_RewardFlyUI.coinBadge.UITransformComponent.anchoredPosition.y-52
  assert(bottom-top>=8,'Simulated badge gap '..name..' '..tostring(size)..' gap='..tostring(bottom-top))
 end
 _MobileScreenFitLogic:FitLobbyBadges()
 assert(_RewardFlyUI.coinBadge.UITransformComponent.anchoredPosition.x==-230,'Repeated fit shifted coin')
 assert(_RewardFlyUI.diamondBadge.UITransformComponent.anchoredPosition.x==-462,'Repeated fit shifted diamond')
 log('[CurrencyBadgeQA] simulatedCanvas='..tostring(size.x)..'x'..tostring(size.y)..' stable=true')
end
root.RectSize=saved
_MobileScreenFitLogic:FitLobbyPanelArt()
_MobileScreenFitLogic:FitLobbyBadges()

local kind="gold"
local target=_RewardFlyUI:GetTargetEntity(kind)
local expected=_RewardFlyUI:GetLayerPosOf(target,_RewardFlyUI.BadgeIconOffsetX,0)
_RewardFlyUI._T.currencyQa.destination=expected
_RewardFlyUI:Hold(kind,8)
_TitleUI._lastCoins=_TitleUI._lastCoins+8
_TitleUI:RefreshCurrencyText()
local src=_RewardFlyUI:GetLayerPosOf(_SkillUI.gradeFilterBtn.Entity,0,-250)
log('[CurrencyBadgeQA] expected='..kind..' x='..tostring(expected.x)..' y='..tostring(expected.y))
_RewardFlyUI:Fly(kind,8,"02a489cccff24a139a6c3582a5871f58",src,0)

local kind="gold"
local qa=_RewardFlyUI._T.currencyQa
assert(_RewardFlyUI:GetHeld(kind)==0,'Held currency did not release')
local expected=qa.destination
for _,sp in ipairs(_RewardFlyUI._sparks) do
 local p=sp.UITransformComponent.anchoredPosition
 assert(math.abs(p.x-expected.x)<.02 and math.abs(p.y-expected.y)<.02,'Arrival sparkle destination mismatch')
end
for _,busy in pairs(_RewardFlyUI._busy) do assert(not busy,'Fly pool did not release') end
local t=kind=='gold' and _TitleUI.coinText or _TitleUI.diamondText
local original=kind=='gold' and qa.coins or qa.diamonds
assert(t.Text==tostring(original+8),'Currency number arrival update')
assert(_GameManager.TotalCoins==qa.serverCoins and _GameManager.Diamond==qa.serverDiamonds,'Server currency modified')
_TitleUI._lastCoins=original
_TitleUI:RefreshCurrencyText()
log('[CurrencyBadgeQA] flyAndArrival='..kind..' sparks=8 numberUpdate=true serverBalancesUnchanged=true')
